sections.title: The ending -kor
sections.content: To say 'at seven', add *-kor* to the number: *hét → hétkor*. The ending never changes with vowel harmony, and it is written together with the number. Ask *Hánykor találkozunk?* (At what time do we meet?). You know *Hány óra van?* for 'what time is it?'; *hétkor* answers 'at what time?'. With half hours, *-kor* goes on the last word: *fél nyolckor* (at half past seven). Noon stays *délben*. New word: *hánykor*.

items.english: At what time do we meet?
The party is at half past seven.
I do not want to work at eight.

sections.content: Days take *-n* (*szombaton*), clock times take *-kor*: *Szombaton nyolckor.* *Egykor*, *ötkor* and *hatkor* are just the number plus *-kor*; no letters change.
